privateWorkspace.title: Projects are stored in this browser
privateWorkspace.description: This browser can't open a folder on disk, so projects and the media you import live in its private storage. Clearing site data deletes them: export project bundles to back them up.
privateWorkspace.notPersisted: The browser didn't make storage persistent. It may clear projects when disk space runs low.

browserSupport.storageUnavailableDescription: {{productName}} keeps projects in a folder on disk or in the browser's private storage, and this window allows neither. Private windows often block storage: open {{productName}} in a regular window.
browserSupport.bundleIntoPrivateStorage: The project and its media will be stored in this browser.
